text:
incident-bot: page: @oncall (sam-oncall) - high-severity: auth failures observed for web console in eu-west-1, elevated 5xx on token verification (Okta). Please ack and triage

katie.ops: seeing ~30% of console logins return 502 from our authn-proxy in eu-west-1. User reports from EU customers + internal console sessions. This started ~08:42 UTC. No deploys in the window.

sam-oncall: acked. I'm on it. grabbing logs from edge and auth-proxy. any correlation with JWKS fetch errors?

maria-sre: I see repeated TLS handshake errors to api.okta.com from the eu-edge egress pool (SNI: api.okta.com). Handshakes are timing out ~300-600ms and then connection reset -> our verify library returns 502. Examples from logs:
```
OKTA-VERIFY: outgoing mTLS handshake failed: TLS alert: handshake_failure
upstream request failed: upstream prematurely closed connection
curl -v 'https://api.okta.com/oauth2/v1/introspect' --header 'Authorization: Bearer ...' -> 52 0  errno 104
```

devraj-platform: checked peering / NAT. No obvious route flaps. Egress IPs healthy. Could be Okta edge thinning or mTLS policy change on their side. Also seeing increased connection attempts hitting different Okta edge IPs then getting closed.

tom-support: CS is seeing ~120 open tickets for login failures from EU customers (web + mobile). Major customers impacted: BrightCo, LedgerFlow (console access). We need to prepare customer comms.

katie.ops: can we fail open to cached verification for console sessions while we investigate? We have a short-lived cached public keys (jwks) that our verifier uses. If Okta is rejecting the TLS handshake intermittently, verifying tokens using cached JWKS avoids live Okta intropsect calls for existing sessions. Thoughts?

maria-sre: we already have a cached JWKS fallback for token verification but the code path still does an introspect for new sessions. We can flip the feature flag to prefer local jwks verification for 15m for any token that includes kid we have cached. Doable in ~8-12min and reversible.

sam-oncall: do it. deploy toggle to prefer-local-jwks -> true (canary eu-west-1 first). Also change proxy circuit-breaker: increase connect timeout and reduce retries to avoid cascading queued requests.

incident-bot: change_flag_request: prefer-local-jwks=true, scope=eu-west-1, requested_by=sam-oncall

devraj-platform: rolling flag to 25% hosts in eu-west-1 now. watch latency/errors.

maria-sre: after flag roll to 100% in eu-west-1: auth-proxy 5xx rate dropped from 28% -> 6% over 10m. TLS handshake errors decreased but not fully resolved. Introspect error rate to Okta still ~15% (timeou ts / resets) for new introspects.

alex-pm: compile customer impact summary for support + sales: affected customers primarily in EU region for last 45m, partial console and API token introspect failures. No data plane data exfiltration. Severity: P2 -> P1 candidate if trend continues.

tom-support: drafting notification: "We're investigating intermittent Okta auth provider failures causing login and token validation errors for EU customers. Workaround: console sessions should resume if you retry; we're enabling cached token verification for a short period. We'll update in 30m."

sam-oncall: action list: 1) enable prefer-local-jwks (done) 2) update circuit breakers (done) 3) open ticket with Okta support + provide TLS logs and affected egress IPs 4) if Okta confirms edge issue, coordinate failover to alternate auth provider for admin console (manual)

maria-sre: created Okta support ticket #OK-88541 with payload and TLS traces. sent via their partner channel and escalated to L2. Okta responded acknowledging degraded connections in the eu-west region and investigating a gateway mTLS handshake regression after a cert rollout. ETA unknown.

incident-bot: pager: handoff scheduled in 40m to oncall second (maria-sre) due to 4hr shift length. handoff_time=1767811380

sam-oncall: starting pre-handoff checklist: document mitigation steps, envs touched, rollbacks. Will leave flag on prefer-local-jwks and watch for replay failures.

devraj-platform: note - enabling prefer-local-jwks increases risk of accepting stale keys if Okta rotated JWKS keys during outage. mitigations: set accept-window=15m and add a fast-refresh job to fetch JWKS every 30s until Okta stable. We can also emit a metric for 'jwks-stale-accepts' to detect if we verified with older key.

katie.ops: please prepare runbook snippet for CS with instructions to escalate customer-facing admin logins to alternate region (us-east-1) if console access still blocked. Include steps to temporarily whitelist admin IPs into eu proxy to bypass edge pool.

maria-sre: handoff accepted. I'm monitoring the Okta ticket and will follow through on the fast-refresh job + canarying a wider fallback if Okta doesn't stabilize in next 30m. Leaving prefer-local-jwks on for now.

sam-oncall: handing off. main open items for next oncall: 1) Okta support updates and verifying their RCA, 2) decide on cross-region failover if TTL policy can't be extended, 3) customer comms cadence.

alex-pm: thanks. i'll coordinate comms with sales + legal for any SLA exposure. please ping me if we need broader outage notice.

Incident summary (for timeline):
- 08:42 UTC: first spikes in 502s for eu-west-1 console logins.
- 08:45 UTC: incident-bot page -> sam-oncall.
- 08:52 UTC: identified TLS/mTLS handshake failures to Okta edges.
- 09:00 UTC: prefer-local-jwks flag rolled in eu-west-1 -> 100% -> immediate reduction in 5xx.
- 09:12 UTC: Okta support ticket created and escalated; they acknowledged edge mTLS regression.
- 09:23 UTC: handoff to maria-sre for monitoring and Okta coordination.

katie.ops: closing note - after 45m remediation the console is largely functional for impacted customers but some mobile token introspects still degrade. Recommend follow-up postmortem and consider adding synthetic Okta mTLS checks from our egress pool to detect future handshake regressions automatically. :memo:

maria-sre: agreed. filing postmortem ticket and will include follow-up actions: synthetic probes, shorter jwks refresh on failover, and review of fallback TTLs.

incident-bot: thread closed for now (no active pages).
